name: Camp Winaukee
description_short: An overnight camp for boys ages 7-15 on Lake Winnipesaukee in Moultonborough, NH, with a strong focus on sports. It has two campuses, the Mainland for boys 7-12 and the Island for boys 13-15. Activities include waterskiing, sailing, paddling, swim lessons and fishing, plus team sports, arts and outdoor adventure.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront on Lake Winnipesaukee. Swimming is supervised by Red Cross Certified Lifeguards and Water Safety Instructors. Mainland boys take part in a Learn to Swim Program, with lessons as often as their swim level requires. Lifeguards with waterski experience drive the ski boats. PFDs are required on motor boats and during all towed watersports. Sailing (Sunfish) and paddleboarding start in shallow water under lifeguard supervision.
